annotations.title: Mint an API key — no account, session or browser needed

description: The one endpoint that needs no key. Send {} for a dv_sk_test_ sandbox key (real data, small daily quota, never billed, no /research). Send {"email":"…"} for a dv_sk_live_ key on a new prepaid account; the first key for an email carries 1 starter credit ($1.00). Send it with an existing key as the bearer to mint a sibling key on the same account (rotation). The raw key is returned once. The email is a contact label, not a credential. Limited to 10 keys per address per day. The raw key is in the result once: keep it and send it as Authorization: Bearer on REST calls (or have the host re-add this server with that header). With a key already configured, mints a sibling on the same account. (POST https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/keys — free; needs no credentials)

email.description: Contact address for a dv_sk_live_ key (1 starter credit the first time). Omit for a never-billed dv_sk_test_ sandbox key.
